metadata.title: Mid-Century Ornate Portrait and Palette Layout

retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a full-body portrait enclosed in a heavy ornate frame on the left, balanced by dense, multi-colored stacked typography and a physical object anchor on the right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition divided vertically: the left side contains a man in a suit standing within a complex, burnt-orange rococo-style frame against a dark background; the right side features a dense block of justified, multi-colored display typography above a realistic watercolor paint tin.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between framed portrait and text block
Color coordination between the frame's orange and the text highlights
Juxtaposition of flat graphic filigree and a realistic 3D object anchor
coreInvariants: Heavy, intricate filigree border around the subject
Stacked, justified text block with varying line heights
High-contrast black background to make colors pop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure, scaled to fit vertically within the left-side frame, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A white watercolor paint tin with a brush, positioned at the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the portrait, moves right to the large display text, then descends through the tracklist to the paint palette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background serves as the primary negative space, providing high contrast for the orange frame and white/yellow text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lemon Yellow and Lime Green (secondary text lines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for the graphic elements against a zero-value black void.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, ultra-bold sans-serif with tight kerning
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing (touching in some areas)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized with a circular flourish
Letters like 'A' and 'R' have very small internal apertures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying colors and scales to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small decorative square icons flanking text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and small counters of the 1960s display style.
Provides the necessary mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black background. On the left, place a man in a 1960s suit inside a large, intricate burnt-orange rococo filigree frame. On the bottom right, place a realistic white watercolor tin with colorful paint cakes and a wooden brush.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a block of justified, ultra-bold sans-serif text in the top right. Alternate colors line by line between orange, yellow, and lime green. Ensure the text is tightly packed.

verificationChecks: Is the frame color consistent with the primary text color?
Is the text block justified and dense?
Does the paint palette look like a physical object rather than a graphic?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man is fully contained within the frame.
Check that the text colors are vibrant against the black.
Verify the ornate frame has a symmetrical, hand-drawn quality.
Confirm the paint palette is positioned at the very bottom right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ornate Frame] + [Portrait] + [Stacked Bold Text] + [Thematic Object Anchor] on a [Solid Dark Background].
